note: Provenance for every photograph on this site that we did not take ourselves. Each entry was verified by SHA-1: the local master is byte-for-byte the file at the source URL, so these are identity matches rather than resemblances. Licences were read off the file page's own wikitext and extmetadata, never inferred from a category, a filename, or a sibling file by the same author. CC BY-SA and NonCommercial files were excluded on purpose: the site applies a colour grade to every image, which creates a derivative, and share-alike would oblige the graded result to carry BY-SA too. The three frames added on 2026-08-28 were sourced in the beauty pass with a deliberate bias to spectacle; each licence was read on its own file page that day, not carried over from the earlier pass.

Wikimedia's Structured Data for this file still carries a stale CC BY-SA 4.0 copyright claim alongside the CC0 one, so any tool that reads Structured Data instead of the page wikitext will report this file as BY-SA — a licence we forbid. The operative licence is CC0. The file was uploaded in 2013 with an empty permission field; a third party tagged it BY-SA 4.0 in 2015 from the uploader's credit page; the author and sole copyright holder then dedicated it CC0 himself in the revision of 2022-09-03. CC0 is the only licence the author has personally written onto this page. Attribution is not legally required here; we credit him anyway.

storageNote: WHERE THE MASTERS LIVE. CC0 / CC BY / public-domain masters are committed in assets-src/sourced/: those licences permit redistribution, and this repository is public. Free-stock masters (Pexels here; Unsplash if any ship) and any photograph used by written permission are NOT committed. They are held in assets-src/stock-local/, which is gitignored, and only the graded derivative the site serves is published. Pexels forbids redistributing its files on other platforms, and a permission granted for a website does not reach a public repository handing out the original. The SHA-1 above is what ties each held master to its licence; qa/credits-guard.mts fails if such a master is found inside the repo. Pixabay-licensed frames are held entirely, not shipped: that licence forbids distributing content on a standalone basis, and a colour grade leaves a photograph substantially the same. CC BY-SA is still excluded from the site and is a separate decision for the client (see the local contact sheet in .hunt/design-reset/by-sa/).
